ssh-lab-server-lite.name: ssh-lab-server-lite (Debian 12)
ssh-lab-server-lite.notes: Low-memory counterpart of ssh-lab-server; exercises and tests in vms/labs/ssh-lab-lite/. Independent runtime segment; original lab tests are shared.

write_files.content:
[DEFAULT]
ignoreip = 127.0.0.1/8 10.0.2.0/24
bantime = 600
findtime = 600
maxretry = 3

[sshd]
enabled = true
port = ssh
backend = systemd

[options]
	UseSyslog

[openSSH]
	sequence    = 7000,8000,9000
	seq_timeout = 5
	command     = /usr/sbin/iptables -I KNOCKD_SSH -s %IP% -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
	tcpflags    = syn

[closeSSH]
	sequence    = 9000,8000,7000
	seq_timeout = 5
	command     = /usr/sbin/iptables -D KNOCKD_SSH -s %IP% -p tcp --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
	tcpflags    = syn

#!/bin/sh
# SSH from the lab segment starts closed; a knock from the client opens it for that address.
# vmctl's own SSH arrives on the NAT NIC (10.0.2.x) and never enters this chain.
iptables -N KNOCKD_SSH 2>/dev/null || iptables -F KNOCKD_SSH
iptables -A KNOCKD_SSH -j DROP
iptables -C INPUT -s 172.20.2.0/24 -p tcp --dport 22 -j KNOCKD_SSH 2>/dev/null || iptables -I INPUT -s 172.20.2.0/24 -p tcp --dport 22 -j KNOCKD_SSH

[Unit]
Description=ssh-lab: SSH from the lab segment closed until a port knock
Before=knockd.service
After=network-pre.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/ssh-lab-knock-chain

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
After=network-online.target ssh-lab-knock-chain.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
# ssh-lan-lite appears only at the runtime boot: retry until it is there.
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

runcmd: systemctl enable rsyslog fail2ban ssh-lab-knock-chain.service knockd.service

vpn-lab-server-lite.name: vpn-lab-server-lite (Alpine)
vpn-lab-server-lite.notes: Low-memory counterpart of vpn-lab-server; exercises and tests in vms/labs/vpn-lab-lite/. Independent runtime segment; original lab tests are shared. Alpine's virt kernel does not load tun by itself: the profile lists it in /etc/modules, or OpenVPN finds no /dev/net/tun (the WireGuard exercises work either way).

post_install_run: command -v wg wg-quick openvpn tcpdump iptables
